title: Prospective held-out legal-rule selection across variable-position matched Horn premise swaps

parent.interpretation: AF29 STOP paired AUC 1.0 in all 8, positive proofs 0 even forced continuation

data.construction: Swap exactly two equal-arity middle premise edges between a productive unary Horn rule and a decoy unary rule; both pair members use exactly the same physical atom/rule permutations, unchanged root facts, marked roles, legal root mask and directed per-node degree sequence. Train/dev swap chain step 1 or 2; held step 1,2,3.
data.local_condition: Exactly equal identity-preserving directed incidence radius-2 neighborhoods around all four root facts, both marked subgoals and the goal, in each matched pair.
data.no_leakage: Never pass split/family/pair index, label, generator logical node IDs, exact shortest distance, oracle action, or true entailment label to policy feature functions.
data.source_separation: Distinct logical templates for train, dev, held depth5, held depth6 and unique physical incidence hashes, including heldout entirely unseen at scoring. Train/dev disjoint physical maps and graph hashes.
data.structural_preflight: Before ranker training/scoring, independently check bitset BFS and host BFS, exact positive length/unreachable negative, public-vs-host rule dynamics, degree parity, radius-two parity, exactly 2 edited rules, split disjointness, heldout 32/32/32 swap balance, and source-only manifests.

training.model: Deterministic 8-feature train-standardized linear action scorer trained with multiclass legal-action softmax on TRAIN states only. Separate fixed seeds determine optimizer initialization; no checkpoint weight updates.
training.states: For every TRAIN reachable graph, all states on one canonical shortest public-host proof plus legal competing actions, deduplicated by (public graph,state); negative STOP root examples available only for the independently fitted STOP diagnostic.
training.labels: Exact shortest-step-reducing legal actions from independent TRAIN BFS; tie labels uniform across all optimal actions. No heldout shortest action used as a scorer feature.
training.optimizer: Full-batch deterministic gradient descent, 500 updates, step 0.1, L2 0.01; score standardization train-only; no dev fitting.
training.development: Choose any learning-rate or STOP diagnostic threshold solely by DEV before held; report exact dev selection; fixed register above optimizer if no pre-data amendment.
training.equal_budget_control: Same feature representation with a randomly initialized, untrained linear action scorer for each seed; equal graph-feature and legal-action work.
training.other_controls: No-training goal-ancestry ranker, first-legal rule, seeded random legal rule, public closure, BFS16 and BFS64.

inference.budget: For positive cases at most exact shortest length+1 successful rule firings, for negative at most two rule decisions. This budget exists only in evaluator; cannot pass to policy.
inference.step: Every rule fired must be currently enabled by public graph and replayed by the independent host; only public graph and current facts enter policy.
inference.primary_policy: RANK+CERT: train-only linear rule ranker, with a publicly computed fixed-point reachable/unreachable certificate computed once at root to STOP negative cases. Attribute all symbolic work and exclude any claim of pure neural STOP.
inference.negative_controls: All legal-action rankers receive the identical once-per-root certificate, including the untrained equal-budget control.
inference.neural_only_diagnostic: RANK+TRAINED_STOP is a separate diagnostic, requiring train/dev-only STOP fit and recording false decisions; never describe CERT as neural negative recognition.
inference.compute: Count every rule examination in certificate, every graph feature evaluation, every inference score evaluation, BFS state expansion and measured wall-clock. Distinguish noncomparable units. Run on fixed CPU runner, never claim equal FLOPs from rule count alone.

primary.interpretation: Scientific PASS means learned action ranking improves heldout proof execution within the same public symbolic negative-certificate wrapper, not a learned reachability theorem, and requires a positive gap against the best equally certified untrained/heuristic controller. Always compare to public closure and bounded BFS.
primary.reporting: All 8 seed rows; 32/32/32 heldout swap positions, 48/48 grammar families, per-case complete trace, counts and denominators, first-off-optimal action diagnostics, paired seed differences against every control, per-rule-work and wall-clock, source hashes and independent host/BFS audit.

registration_integrity.source_protocol_first: PROTOCOL.json committed before any AF30 generator/training/evaluation files
registration_integrity.amendment_rule: Any change before held scoring must be documented as dated pre-scoring amendment; after scoring retain original verdict and treat new tuning as a new experiment.
registration_integrity.predecessor: Do not rewrite AF22 through AF29 registered science verdicts or original checkpoints.
